newsitem.title: USA: Hormel Foods in alliance with Danish firm.
newsitem.headline: Hormel Foods in alliance with Danish firm.

text.p: Hormel Foods Corp on Wednesday said it entered into an alliance with Tulip International, a food company in Arhus, Denmark.
"Our relationship with Tulip enables Hormel Foods to expand internationally its prepared foods business," V. Allan Krejci, director of public relations for Hormel Foods, said in a statement.

"By leveraging the expertise of two of the world's leading food companies, we are able to grow distribution of established product lines and develop and introduce new food choices into Europe," he said.
No further details on the alliance were available.
Tulip International, established in Denmark in 1997, is a worldwide food company with a strong presence in Europe, Hormel said.

"As a company, Hormel Foods will be able to take advantage of this significant manufacturing base," Krejci said, "while also capitalizing on Tulip's extensive research and development and sale and distribution capabilities."
